# baseline-1.1.0 — historical fixture, not the public 1.1.0

These three scripts are a frozen snapshot of an **early internal iteration (11.10.2026)** that was locally numbered "1.1.0" before the public 1.0.0. They are **not** the sources of the public release v1.1.0; the current sources are in `src/app`.

Tiers 1–4 of `run_offline_e2e_tests.ps1` check that these files exist and that scratch activity leaves their hashes unchanged. Do not edit, rename or "update" them: the folder name and the files are part of those assertions.
